Udaipur & Kumbhalgarh Expedition

Udaipur — Lake Pichola — City Palace — Kumbhalgarh Fort — Saheliyon Ki Bari — Fateh Sagar Lake

About This Trip

Explore the romantic City of Lakes and the majestic grand fortresses of Rajasthan on this 3-day immersive getaway. Uncover the regal heritage of Udaipur with visits to the iconic City Palace, peaceful boat rides on Lake Pichola, and scenic sunsets at Fateh Sagar Lake. Venture into the Aravalli hills to witness the world's second-longest wall at the formidable Kumbhalgarh Fort. Designed for culture lovers and weekend wanderers, this trip offers the perfect blend of royal architecture, vibrant local culture, and stunning landscapes.

Itinerary

Overnight Volvo Bus / Train journey from Delhi to Udaipur.

Arrive in Udaipur, check in to hotel. Visit City Palace, Jagdish Temple, and enjoy a sunset boat ride at Lake Pichola. Evening at leisure near Lal Ghat.

Day trip to Kumbhalgarh Fort to explore its massive walls and palaces. Return to Udaipur in the evening for sunset at Fateh Sagar Lake.

Visit Saheliyon Ki Bari and Bagore Ki Haveli. Explore local markets for handicrafts before taking an overnight Volvo Bus / Train back to Delhi.

Arrive back in Delhi in the early morning.
